'''Dalgona coffee''' ({{lang|kr|달고나 커피}}) is a refreshing, cold [[Cookbook:Beverages|drink]] originating from [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Korea|South Korea]]. 

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Coffee|instant coffee]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 tbsp warm water
* [[Cookbook:Milk|Milk]]
* Ice cubes (optional—you can omit if you're using hot milk if you prefer hot coffee)

== Procedure ==
# Put instant coffee and sugar in a bowl.
# Gradually add water while whipping with a hand [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]] (highly recommended; if not available, manually [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] the mixture up to 400 times).
# Pour milk in a cup, add ice cubes, and add the cream on top.
